result.description: A & M Packaging Pty Ltd  A & M Packaging Pty Limited is a leading Australian provider of flexible packaging solutions, committed to quality, innovation, and operational excellence. We provide comprehensive services ranging from packaging design and lamination to conversion and distribution. We are currently seeking a highly skilled Quality Engineering Officer to join our team and drive technical optimization across our manufacturing operations.  The Quality Engineering Officer will play a critical role in optimizing our packaging production lines and manufacturing technologies. You will be responsible for analysing system performance, implementing process improvements, and ensuring that our manufacturing workflows operate at peak efficiency, quality, and compliance. This role bridges the gap between production and engineering, requiring a hands-on approach to technical troubleshooting, equipment validation, and data-driven continuous improvement.   Benefits   Task & responsibilities   Evaluate manufacturing lines and equipment performance to pinpoint opportunities for increasing productivity, efficiency, and product quality.  Conduct root cause analysis on equipment failures and process anomalies, implementing engineering-based solutions to restore and enhance operational reliability.  Formulate and execute process improvement strategies aimed at maximizing resource utilization and reducing operational waste.  Assess production methods against established technical specifications and engineering standards to ensure all manufacturing processes remain within defined parameters.  Provide hands-on technical guidance and troubleshooting for production machinery and process technologies to mitigate downtime and boost system output.  Design, refine, and enforce technical documentation, standard operating procedures, and process controls to maintain consistency in production outcomes.  Partner with production, quality, and engineering teams to streamline packaging systems and refine manufacturing workflows.  Participate in the commissioning, testing, and validation of new manufacturing assets to ensure they meet performance and engineering benchmarks.  Develop and oversee testing and inspection protocols to verify process capability and maintain rigorous product performance standards.  Analyse production metrics and performance data to identify operational trends, supporting the implementation of continuous improvement projects.  Assist in the maintenance of operational and quality management frameworks to ensure alignment with industry regulations and internal business requirements.  Track the success of corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), evaluating the impact of implemented solutions and recommending further technical upgrades where needed.    Qualification & experience   A tertiary qualification (Bachelor’s degree or Higher) in Engineering, Engineering Technology, or a related technical discipline.  Proven professional experience in a manufacturing, packaging, or industrial processing environment.  At least 3 years of professional experience in a similar role.  Solid understanding of engineering principles, production workflows, and manufacturing process controls.  Proficiency in utilising ERP systems (e.g., SAP or Microsoft Dynamics 365) for production data analysis and operational monitoring.  Demonstrated ability to conduct root cause analysis, troubleshoot equipment issues, and implement effective engineering solutions.  Excellent communication skills, with the ability to provide technical guidance and collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams.   About Company    A & M Packaging Pty Limited is a leading Australian manufacturer and supplier of flexible packaging solutions, specializing in high-performance lamination, conversion, and distribution services across the country. We partner with a diverse range of industries to deliver consistently high standards of manufacturing quality, technical precision, and operational efficiency.  With a strong commitment to engineering excellence and service, we provide tailored packaging solutions designed to meet the complex technical requirements of each client. Our business places significant emphasis on process innovation, workplace safety, and continuous improvement to ensure our production systems are highly efficient, reliable, and performance-driven.  At A & M Packaging, our team members are dedicated professionals who take pride in their technical expertise and contribute directly to the innovation and operational success of our manufacturing operations. result.description:
About the role
The Senior GRC Security Consultant leads governance, risk and compliance (GRC) engagements for Spartans Security clients, providing expert advice and hands-on delivery across security strategies, control frameworks (e.g. ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF, ASD Essential Eight), risk assessment, incident response uplift, policy development, and security program roadmaps. The role operates in a CISO-as-a-Service capacity across multiple customers, building stakeholder trust, uplifting security posture and ensuring alignment with regulatory and industry requirements.

Core Tasks and Duties
•	Independently scope and deliver security GRC engagements including assessments against ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF and ASD Essential Eight; develop remediation roadmaps and maturity uplift plans.
•	Conduct cyber governance, risk and compliance activities, including assessing cyber risks, reviewing security controls, and ensuring alignment with security frameworks, standards, and best practices.
•	Lead or contribute to cyber security assessments, including control effectiveness reviews, gap analyses, compliance reviews, and the development of security standards, policies and guidelines.
•	Analyse and investigate cyber security incidents and breaches, performing root cause analysis, assessing impact, and recommending corrective actions to strengthen future resilience.
•	Monitor security alerts, threat intelligence, logs and events, identifying potential security risks and undertaking threat hunting activities to detect malicious activity or vulnerabilities.
•	Coordinate and lead incident response operations, including containment, eradication, recovery and post incident reporting, and manage collaboration across internal and external teams.
•	Develop and maintain cyber security architecture, ensuring secure design principles are applied across systems, networks and cloud environments, and recommending improvements based on emerging threats.
•	Provide specialist cyber security advice and guidance to senior leaders, project teams and business stakeholders on security strategy, risk mitigation and security best practices.
•	Implement, review and uplift security controls, including identity and access management (IAM), network security, endpoint protection, vulnerability management and cloud security controls.
•	Coordinate Security Operations Centre (SOC) functions, including case management, escalation handling, SIEM/SOAR workflows and ongoing monitoring improvements.
•	Support the development and implementation of cyber policies, procedures and documentation, including incident response plans, standard operating procedures, audit evidence and compliance reports, ensuring alignment to customer risk appetite and regulatory obligations (e.g., APRA CPS 234, SOCI where applicable).
•	Participate in internal and external cyber security audits, coordinating activities, preparing documentation, responding to findings and ensuring continuous improvement.
•	Deliver cyber awareness and training support, helping improve cyber maturity across the organisation by coaching staff on cyber risks and secure practices.
•	Accept responsibility for the processes, procedures and operational management associated with system security and disaster recovery planning.
•	Analyse, recommend, install and maintain software security applications; monitor contractual obligations, performance delivery and service level agreements (SLAs).
•	Perform CISO-as-a-Service functions for multiple customers, including risk governance, executive reporting, board briefings and program oversight.
•	Review, uplift and test incident response plans; coordinate exercises and lessons-learned to strengthen cyber resilience.
•	Provide subject matter expertise on operational security processes (incident/vulnerability management, system hardening, security governance) across on-premises and cloud environments (e.g., Microsoft 365/Azure, AWS).
•	Maintain and govern Information Security Risk Registers; track treatments and drive timely remediation with accountable owners.
•	Define methodologies for identifying critical information assets and associated risks; perform business impact analyses and control mapping.
•	Lead stakeholder engagement with client executives, vendors and service providers; act as a trusted governance and assurance liaison.
•	Produce high-quality deliverables (assessment reports, statements of applicability, audit findings, metrics dashboards) and present outcomes to technical and non-technical audiences.
•	Mentor junior consultants, contribute to service development and support the creation of new GRC offerings and reusable accelerators.
•	Support pre-sales activities including proposal input, level-of-effort estimation and solution design for GRC engagements.

Required Skills and Experience:
•	Demonstrated experience delivering senior-level GRC engagements across multiple industries (consulting or in-house).
•	Deep knowledge of security frameworks and regulatory standards (ISO/IEC 27001, NIST CSF, ASD Essential Eight, PCI DSS; desirable: APRA CPS 234, SOCI).
•	Proficiency in security governance, risk assessment, control design, policy development and metrics/reporting.
•	Strong stakeholder management, communication and influencing skills, including executive reporting.
•	Hands-on familiarity with enterprise and cloud environments (e.g., Microsoft AD, Microsoft 365/Azure, AWS) and common security controls (firewalls, EDR/SIEM, WAF, IAM).
•	Ability to work independently across concurrent engagements, meeting deadlines and quality expectations.

Qualifications & Experience?
•	Bachelor’s degree in information security, Computer Science, Information Systems or related discipline (or equivalent experience).
•	10+ years’ total experience in information security, including 4+ years in security consulting and/or GRC leadership roles.
•	Experience working within international or multinational organisations (particularly in the telecommunications or banking sectors) is highly regarded. 
•	Exposure to global security standards and cross-border GRC or cybersecurity programs across diverse geographic environments is strongly preferred.
•	Must hold at least three of the following relevant certifications: CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CISA, ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Implementer, and ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Auditor.
•	Evidence of continuing professional development and familiarity with current threat and compliance landscapes.

Right to Work Requirement:
Applicants must have the legal right to work in Australia at the time of application.  

Working Conditions
This is a permanent base role, with hybrid work arrangement (2 days remote + 3 days from office) and open to candidates in Melbourne that have full working right/visa.
Hybrid work model (on-site client meetings as required). Some interstate travel may be required based on client needs.

result.description: Growmore Partners Pty Ltd T/A FORMAL FINISH COATINGS  The Mechanical Engineering Technician (ANZSCO 312512) is responsible for supporting the installation, testing, maintenance, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of mechanical equipment and production systems used in the company's spray-painting and surface-finishing operations. The role ensures machinery operates safely, efficiently and reliably, minimising downtime while maintaining the company's high standards of quality, productivity and workplace safety.     The Mechanical Engineering Technician provides technical support for the maintenance and optimisation of production machinery, spray-painting systems, compressors, conveyors, curing equipment and other mechanical plant used throughout the coating process. Working closely with management and production personnel, the position assists in diagnosing equipment faults, implementing preventative maintenance programs, improving operational efficiency and ensuring compliance with Australian safety and engineering standards. The role contributes to the smooth delivery of high-quality coating solutions for commercial, industrial and residential projects.      DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES    •    Install, commission, inspect and maintain mechanical equipment used in spray-painting, coating and finishing operations.  •    Perform preventative maintenance on spray booths, compressors, pumps, conveyors, drying systems and associated mechanical equipment.  •    Diagnose mechanical faults, investigate equipment failures and carry out repairs to minimise production downtime.  •    Monitor machinery performance and recommend engineering improvements to increase operational efficiency and equipment reliability.  •    Assist engineers with testing, calibration and commissioning of new machinery and production equipment.  •    Prepare maintenance schedules, inspection reports, technical documentation and equipment service records.  •    Ensure all plant and machinery comply with workplace health and safety requirements, Australian Standards and company procedures.  •    Coordinate with suppliers and contractors regarding equipment servicing, spare parts procurement and technical support.  •    Support continuous improvement initiatives by analysing production data and recommending mechanical process enhancements.  •    Provide technical assistance to production staff on the safe and efficient operation of mechanical equipment.      QUALIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS    •    AQF associate degree, Advanced Diploma or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering Technology, Engineering Technology or a closely related discipline, or an equivalent overseas qualification recognised in Australia (ANZSCO Skill Level 2).  •    Demonstrated experience in the installation, testing, maintenance, fault diagnosis and repair of mechanical equipment, machinery and production systems in an industrial or manufacturing environment.  •    Ability to interpret engineering drawings, technical specifications, schematics and maintenance manuals, with sound knowledge of mechanical, hydraulic and pneumatic systems.  •    Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to conduct equipment inspections, prepare technical reports and recommend improvements to enhance operational efficiency.  •    Sound understanding of Australian Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) requirements, engineering standards and preventative maintenance practices, with the ability to work effectively both independently and within a multidisciplinary team.  •    Experience in the spray-painting, surface finishing, manufacturing or industrial coating industry will be highly regarded.      WORKING HOURS    Full-time – 38 hours per week      BENEFITS    •    Competitive remuneration package.  •    Ongoing professional development and technical training.  •    Stable full-time employment.  •    Opportunity to work with modern industrial equipment and technologies.  •    Supportive and safety-focused work environment.  •    Career progression opportunities within the business.     About Company    GROWMORE PARTNERS PTY LTD, trading as FORMAL FINISH COATINGS, is a Victorian-owned specialist spray-painting and surface finishing company providing premium coating solutions for the shopfitting, cabinet making, construction and commercial fit-out industries. Operating from its purpose-built application facility in Campbellfield, the company delivers high-quality polyurethane coatings, custom colour matching, joinery finishes, glass splashbacks and specialised surface treatments using Australian-made materials. With extensive industry experience, Formal Finish Coatings has completed projects for commercial buildings, retail fitouts, airports and residential developments, earning a reputation for quality workmanship, reliability and exceptional customer service      Work Type:  Full time   Salary:  $80000-90000   Job Publish:  25-07-2026   Job Expire:  24-08-2026  Apply on:  Mechanical Engineering Technician Job here!
